responsibility: Provides the top-level `rustc` compiler executable. Its root file, `compiler/rustc/src/main.rs`, defines the process entry point and performs the small amount of binary-specific setup required before invoking `rustc_driver`, including ensuring the configured allocator support such as jemalloc is linked into the executable when enabled so the compiler runs with the intended allocation behavior across the rustc/LLVM boundary. In the compiler as a whole, this crate’s stable role is to package and launch the Rust compiler as an executable, delegating actual compilation orchestration to the driver after establishing the executable-level runtime environment.
